ludmila.name: Ludmila Domingos
ludmila.bio:
After nearly a decade working across marketing and technology in Brazil, Italy, and Ireland, Ludmila founded {{brandName}} to bridge the gap between advanced AI and the practical needs of small businesses.

Her experience across different markets gives her a unique perspective on the challenges small teams face — especially the manual work that defeats morale and prevents growth. 

Today she leads client work and coaching in Pipa, and runs the AI Coaching programme in English and Portuguese.

padraig.name: Padraig O'Donoghue
padraig.bio:
Padraig is a full-stack software engineer and former History & Politics teacher.

His approach is straightforward: simplify the complex and create practical solutions. Padraig brings technical depth combined with a teacher's ability to make technology accessible and understandable for non-technical business owners.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
philosophy.content:
We don't sell services we haven't used ourselves. Every tool we recommend, every automation we set up — we've tested it in our own business first.

We're not trying to be a big consultancy. We're two people who know how to make technology work for small teams without breaking the bank or requiring a computer science degree.

difference.title: The difference is in the request
difference.contextEx: "I'm a small-animal vet. Write post-spay instructions for a female dog for the owner to read on WhatsApp: simple language, up to 10 points, a warm tone, and at the end the warning signs that mean they should come back to the clinic."

safety.title: If it identifies the owner, it doesn't go in
safety.desc: A whole block of the class is about safety: what Brazil's data protection law (LGPD) and professional confidentiality require when you use AI. You'll take this traffic light back to your clinic.
safety.green: Green – OK to use: articles, protocols, drug leaflets and general texts for pet owners.
safety.amber: Amber – only without identifying details: the patient's clinical information, with nothing that leads back to the owner.
safety.red: Red – never: the owner's name, CPF (tax ID), phone number, address or email, and complete documents.
